rules.message: SQL belongs in the repository layer, not in a controller
rules.fix: move the query into src/modules/<module>/repository.js and call it through service.js

rules.message: only repositories may touch the database module
a module may use another module only through its public index.js
rules.fix: export what you need from src/modules/<other>/index.js and import that file

rules.message: an unresolved merge conflict marker was committed
rules.fix: resolve the conflict and delete the <<<<<<< / >>>>>>> lines

rules.message: a private key is in the repository
rules.fix: remove it, rotate the key, and load it from a secret store or an untracked env file

rules.message: a tagged debug line from /stack-agent:debug is still in the code
rules.fix: delete every line tagged [DEBUG-...] (grep for the tag); keep the regression test instead
